title: coordination.md and tools.md say what reads kbsettings.effective today, not what will
goal: the docs name as readers of kbsettings.effective only the tools that import it, and name the coord hook, kbmon and the explain command once each of them does

run:
import re, glob, sys
doc = open("kb/_self/coordination.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
claims = [l for l in doc.splitlines() if "kbsettings.effective" in l and re.search(r"coord hook|kbmon|explain", l)]
readers = [f for f in glob.glob("_tools/*.py") if not f.endswith(("kbsettings.py", "test_kbsettings.py")) and "kbsettings" in open(f, encoding="utf-8").read()]
print("doc lines naming readers", len(claims), "| tools that import kbsettings", len(readers))
sys.exit(0 if not claims or readers else 1)
